title: PGAA: a claim-state compiler for perturbation-transcriptomic evidence
description: PGAA is an executable claim-state compiler for perturbation transcriptomics. It combines internal decision state, ranking stability, external evidence, source-data provenance, and branch-specific promotion gates to emit bounded manuscript claim states, so that an exploratory signal cannot be promoted to a biological or translational conclusion without the evidence a promotion rule requires. Distribution-aware statistics (a Wasserstein statistic for full expression-distribution shifts and a histogram-shape statistic for responder-associated expression-shape changes) are retained as upstream scoring modules that supply scores to the compiler; they are not claimed as the main methodological novelty. This archive is a code-only software release and excludes manuscript drafts, submission materials, figures, source-data tables, and review materials.
